data.name: Ghailum
data.long_meaning: One who sets free, liberator. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'gh-l-m', which means 'to release, set free, or liberate'. In Islamic history, the name Ghailum is associated with various figures who have been instrumental in freeing their communities from oppression and tyranny.

in_arabic.name: غيلم
in_arabic.meaning: الغيلم اسم يعني الغامض أو المختفي عن العيان

in_hindi.name: घैलुम
in_hindi.meaning: घैलुम का अर्थ है रहस्यमय या छुपा हुआ

in_pashto.name: غیلوم
in_pashto.meaning: غیلوم د پټ یا نامعلوم مطلب دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: غیلوم د عربي نوم دی چې د پټ یا نامعلوم مطلب دی. دا نوم د پښتنو او افغانانو په ميراثي سبک کې کارول کیږي او د پټي يا غيبي معنا لری.

Because of this, it has been given to many prominent figures in Islamic history who have led movements for freedom, such as Ghailum ibn Rib'i, the founder of the Rwabvu resistance movement against European colonization in East Africa in the late 19th century. Additionally, the name can be found in folktales and literary works as a symbol of heroism and valour.
